source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Fuel Tank and Exhaust Systems, p.8-1

procedures.title: Fuel tank: drain by siphoning
steps: There is no drain plug, so siphon the fuel out.
Get about 10 feet of 3/8" I.D. hose and cut a flap-type slit about 18" from one end, angled toward the short end (see figure 1 in the manual).
Push a small pipe nipple, slightly larger in O.D. than the hose I.D., into the other end.
Feed the nipple end down the filler neck with the hose's natural curl pointing down until you hear it hit the tank bottom.
Put the free end in a suitable container, then aim an air hose downward into the slit to start the fuel flowing.
notes: Corvette: the tank gauge (sending unit) is on the lower side of the tank and can be serviced without removing the tank; the tank straps hinge at the tank support and bolt at the rear end.
